fields.description: The doctype this rule applies to, e.g. Timesheet Submission.
fields.label: Reference Doctype

fields.description: The workflow_state that means "awaiting the approver's action".
fields.label: Pending Workflow State

fields.description: How long a document can sit in the Pending Workflow State before it's considered overdue and breach notices/reminders fire.
fields.label: SLA (Hours)

fields.description: Fieldname on the Reference Doctype that links to the submitting Employee. Options are populated once Reference Doctype is set.
fields.label: Employee Field

fields.description: Notify the submitter once the SLA is breached that their document has not yet been reviewed.
fields.label: Notify Submitter on Breach

fields.description: Automatically remind the approver once the SLA is breached, without waiting for the submitter to resurface it.
fields.label: Auto-Remind Approver on Breach

fields.description: How to find the approver: the submitting employee's supervisor, or a specific field on the document.
fields.label: Approver Type
fields.options:
Reports To (Supervisor)
Fixed Field on Document

fields.description: Fieldname on the Reference Doctype holding the approver's User or Employee link. Options are populated once Reference Doctype is set.
fields.label: Approver Field

fields.description: Let the submitter manually resurface the document to the approver while it is pending.
fields.label: Allow Submitter to Resurface to Approver
